text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the presents! A 
large bento box and an aroma diffuser—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, I want to make sure I use it properly, 
so may I ask for the details...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's an extra-large, custom-made bento 
box. Eating a big lunch gives you energy, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Lunch... eating a lot... let's see, "Gutsy 
Carrot for an Umamusume who eats well"... 
got it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please use the aroma diffuser from me 
after your training. It's absolutely 
perfect for refreshing yourself~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
An aroma diffuser for refreshing... 
'Moisturize the soil by healing with 
scents,' right!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-chan is so admirable~. Always 
taking notes on everything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to forget anything I've taken 
in. I truly believe that accumulating all 
this effort is what leads to victory!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of race it is, I will 
win! In the end, I'll even have luck on my 
side!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Even if you win a race, no one would 
ever think it was just luck, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you are a formidable champion who 
spares no effort. What you hold in your 
hands was seized through your own 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ! Both of you... Th-Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If you spare no effort, the winter 
carrots will be sweet." Ehehe, I made sure 
to take good notes on those words just 
now!
